1.w: A Psalm of David. Unto YHWH [is] the earth and its fullness, the world and those dwelling in it.

2.w: For He has founded it upon the seas, and upon the rivers He established it.

3.w: Who will ascend onto the hill of YHWH, or who will stand in His holy place?

4.w: The one clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, and has not sworn by deceit.

5.w: He will lift up a blessing from YHWH, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

6.w: This [is] the generation of those seeking Him, those seeking Your face, [O God] of Jacob. Selah

7.w: lift up, O gates, your⁺ heads, and be lifted up, O ancient doors, and the King of Glory shall come in!

8.w: Who [is] this King of Glory? YHWH strong and mighty, YHWH mighty [in] battle!

9.w: Lift up, O gates, your⁺ heads, and be lifted up, O ancient doors, and the King of glory shall come [in]!

10.w: Who is this King of glory? YHWH of Hosts, He [is] the King of Glory! Selah
